statement: Broad format detection/extraction is a solved problem family; ActaKit need not hand-write every office/archive parser.
actakit_implication: Prefer mature libraries or converters for common formats.

statement: Unstructured already formalizes fast/high-resolution/OCR routing as different strategies.
actakit_implication: Escalation is established practice; ActaKit should own a civic-specific policy rather than inventing the idea.

statement: Broad parser breadth and high-fidelity document understanding are different optimization targets.
actakit_implication: A catch-all parser can be fallback/detector without becoming the highest-quality processor for every format.

statement: A Java-centric runtime would materially enlarge ActaKit deployment if Tika were core.
actakit_implication: Keep Tika as reference/fallback candidate unless Civic Bench demonstrates unique value.
